I can't confirm that no burning occurred, but I can say that no satellite thermal detection was recorded on the property.

**What the evidence shows:** NASA FIRMS returned zero thermal anomaly detections intersecting ASSET-F04 between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-03. All sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period.

**What it doesn't show:** Absence of a detection doesn't prove absence of fire. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may not be picked up. The result also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any land change, or anything outside this period.

**Suggested wording:** "No FIRMS thermal detections intersected the asset during 4 Oct–3 Nov 2026, with full sensor coverage." If you need stronger confirmation, burned-area imagery or a site report would be needed.
